The `android.security.keystore.UserNotAuthenticatedException` occurred because `TokenVault` generates its Android Keystore key with `.setUserAuthenticationRequired(true)` and a validity duration of 30 seconds (`setUserAuthenticationParameters(30, ...)`). Initializing the cipher via `vault.save(token)` requires the user to authenticate via biometrics or device credentials first.

### Fix
In [MainActivity.kt](file:///mnt/01DC198BE9192500/github/Schooldev/3S-study-work/trials/e4/c5-agy-A-r3/work/app/src/main/kotlin/vn/shelftap/lab/MainActivity.kt#L28-L71), added biometric / device-credential authentication using `androidx.biometric.BiometricPrompt` before attempting Keystore operations:

1. Prompt the user using `BiometricPrompt` with `BIOMETRIC_STRONG or DEVICE_CREDENTIAL` authenticators matching the key specification in [TokenVault.kt](file:///mnt/01DC198BE9192500/github/Schooldev/3S-study-work/trials/e4/c5-agy-A-r3/work/app/src/main/kotlin/vn/shelftap/lab/TokenVault.kt#L25-L29).
2. Upon authentication success (`onAuthenticationSucceeded`), execute `vault.save(token)` and `vault.load()` within the authorized timeout window.
